summary.en: One step at a time, inside the palace.

text.en: The general (帅 for Red, 将 for Black) is the most important piece. If your general is trapped, you lose.
text.zh: 将帅是最重要的棋子。老将被困死，就输了。

text.en: The general moves one point at a time along a line: forward, back or sideways. It never moves diagonally.
text.zh: 将帅每次沿直线走一步：前进、后退或横走，不能斜走。

text.en: Move your general to collect both stars. Remember: it can't leave the palace.
text.zh: 走动老帅，吃掉两颗星星。记住：不能出九宫。

text.en: The black chariot gives check along the file! Move your general out of its line.
text.zh: 黑车在纵线上将军！把老帅移出这条线。

hint.zh: 横走一步，离开这条纵线。

wrong.en: Your general is still on the chariot's line.
wrong.zh: 老帅还在车的攻击线上。

success.en: Safe! Stepping out of the line is one way to escape check.
success.zh: 安全了！走出攻击线是应将的一种方法。

text.en: Can the general leave the palace?

explanation.en: The general always stays in its palace.
explanation.zh: 将帅永远不能离开九宫。
